dz: 拿破仑第一次（有条件）退位，并任命他的儿子拿破仑二世为法国皇帝，两天后无条件退位。
de: Napoleon abdicates (conditionally) for the first time and names his son Napoleon II as Emperor of the French, followed by unconditional abdication two days later.

dz: 大不列颠国王查理二世所宣布的布雷达宣言,除其他外,承诺对英国内战和Interregnum期间所犯之罪行,对所有皇室主义者和君主制的反对者给予大赦.

de: Death of the Venetian Doge Tommaso Mocenigo, under whose rule victories were achieved against the Kingdom of Hungary and against the Ottoman Empire at the Battle of Gallipoli (1416).
